conviction_note: Near zero. Q3 2026 was the worst A-share quarter in two years: Shanghai -6.16%, ChiNext -27.8%, STAR 50 -30.7% (source dated 2026-10-05). But the index data is fully public, the stock has drifted -27% since the Q2 print to about 0.65x its US$637M cash, and the three confirmed prior reactions were -0.7%, +2.8% and -0.7%. The negatives on the quarter are offset by a possible capital-return announcement and a washed-out tape. The findings sum (+0.2) and the scaled number (-0.16) differ in sign only inside rounding; both are noise-level, and the gap is not information.

findings.finding: Q3 2026 (Jul-Sep) was the worst A-share quarter since the September 2024 rally began: Shanghai Composite -6.16%, Shenzhen Component -20.47%, ChiNext -27.8%, STAR 50 -30.7% (East Money, 2026-10-05). The CFO said on the Q2 call that an A-share adjustment 'did come in in July'. Noah's performance-based income was RMB100.7M in Q1 2026 and RMB139.4M in Q2 2026, against RMB21.8M in Q3 2025, so Q3 2026 performance fees and mainland public-securities revenue (RMB206.5M in Q2, +56.7% YoY) are likely to fall sharply quarter on quarter. On my estimate, total net revenues land around RMB520-570M, against RMB619.9M in Q2 and RMB632.9M in Q3 2025.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 printed revenue -1.5% YoY with op income +34%, and the stock went 8.77 to 8.71 (-0.7%). Q1 2026 printed revenue +1.8% and op margin 37.8%, and the stock went 10.10 to 10.38 (+2.8%). Q3 2025 printed revenue -7.4% YoY and the stock went 10.44 to 10.37 (-0.7%). These closes are from Yahoo chart v8. Revenue surprises on this name have moved the stock little.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the index moves are fully public and the stock fell 27% after the Q2 print. What may not be priced is the size of the performance-fee drop, since Q1 and Q2 carried RMB100-140M of carry that management told investors not to annualise. If the market had fully priced a ~RMB100M sequential revenue drop, the stock would not still carry a $9.85 consensus target. The fall to 0.65x cash suggests most of it is priced.
findings.independence: Proxy (macro to company). The company source is the Q2 2026 release's performance-fee and segment lines (https://finviz.com/news/385484/noah-holdings-limited-announces-unaudited-financial-results-for-the-second-quarter-of-2026) and the CFO's 'July adjustment' remark (https://www.webull.com/news/15479272959984640). Private-fund industry data shows only +2.37% average return YTD to September (eastmoney, 2026-10-15, https://finance.eastmoney.com/a/202610153897052877.html, snippet_only).

findings.finding: The nearest counterparty for mainland fund distribution, East Money, reported its 3Q26 operating revenue line (mostly fund distribution) at RMB1.136B: +17.68% YoY and -6.62% QoQ (Huachuang Securities note on East Money's 3Q26 report, 2026-10-25). Fund-distribution volumes held up year on year despite the index fall. That supports Noah's mainland mutual-fund distribution (Q3 2025 mainland public securities was a low RMB115.9M base) being flat to up YoY even as carry falls.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025: mainland public securities grew +8.7% YoY and the stock moved -0.7%. No separate reaction to this line is identifiable.
findings.why_not_priced: A counterparty's line item that no Noah preview cites. If it were priced, the stock would not have treated Q3 as a uniform collapse, falling 27% with no company news. The effect is small, because Noah's Q2 mainland revenue was carry-heavy.
findings.independence: Different source from finding 1 and points the opposite way on the distribution line. snippet_only: the figure came through a search summary of the broker note, and the page was not fetched.

findings.finding: Noah carries a listed investment through equity-method affiliates that is marked to market. In Q1 2026 the loss from equity in affiliates was RMB65.3M (+464.6% YoY), which took non-GAAP NI from about RMB216M ex-item to RMB133.9M. In Q3 2025 the same line produced a fair-value gain that lifted NI +62.6%. Given the Q3 2026 tech drawdown (ChiNext -27.8%, STAR -30.7%), a Q3 2026 loss on this line is more likely than a gain. That would hit both GAAP and non-GAAP EPS against the Q3 2025 comp of RMB3.26 non-GAAP EPS per ADS.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 printed NI -16.3% on this item and the stock rose +2.8% the next session (10.10 to 10.38). The market looked through it.
findings.why_not_priced: The investment is not named, so nobody can mark it. But the Q1 precedent shows holders ignore it, and that is why it is sized at a fraction.
findings.independence: Shares the index source with finding 1 for the direction of the mark. The company document is the Q1 release. The Q3 2025 comparison is https://finviz.com/news/239078/noah-holdings-limited-announces-unaudited-financial-results-for-the-third-quarter-of-2025.

findings.finding: The international business is shrinking under a regulatory clampdown. On 2026-05-22 the CSRC and seven ministries launched action against illegal cross-border securities and fund activity, and the SFC and HKMA issued circulars the same day. On 2026-09-04 the CSRC drafted private-fund fundraising rules that scrutinise Hong Kong intermediaries and wealth-management channels serving mainland investors. In Q2 2026, international wealth management revenue was -31.3% YoY, international insurance -31.1%, and overseas RM headcount -36.2%. Management said legacy revenue is 'being phased out faster than the new engines are coming online' and gave no timeline for the transition. Q3 2025 international WM was RMB146.2M, so another ~-30% YoY print is likely, and commentary on the call could extend the transition.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 international WM was -31.3% and the stock moved -0.7% on the day, then drifted -27% over three months. The line is punished through drift rather than on the print.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the stock is -48.8% from its 52-week high and trades below cash, which is what a market pricing a structural decline looks like. What is unpriced is only whether management quantifies the transition on this call.
findings.independence: Company document: the Q2 2026 release segment lines (https://finviz.com/news/385484/noah-holdings-limited-announces-unaudited-financial-results-for-the-second-quarter-of-2026) and the Q2 call (https://www.webull.com/news/15479272959984640). Regulatory follow-up: https://www.sidley.com/en/insights/newsupdates/2026/09/china-to-tighten-private-fundraising-rules-amid-cross-border-distribution-scrutiny (2026-09-21).

findings.finding: The balance sheet exceeds the market cap. Cash and equivalents were RMB4,322.7M (US$637.1M) at 2026-06-30, the 2025 dividend (RMB612M payable at June 30) was paid in July, and there is no interest-bearing debt. Against that, the equity is worth about 6.29 x ~66M ADS ≈ US$420M; a third-party quote page put the market cap at $453.9M at $6.77 on 2026-11-10 (snippet_only). On the Q2 call the CFO said shareholder returns would be sustained at 'at least a comparable level', with the ratio not yet decided and no new buyback commitment. Q1 2026 repurchases were ~1.81M ADS for US$20M. A buyback authorisation, a special dividend or a payout policy announced with the Q3 release would land on a stock at about 0.65x cash.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q4 2025 release (March 2026) proposed a 100%-of-non-GAAP payout. The stock went 11.33 to 9.89 (-12.7%) on 2026-03-26, but that release date and the downgrade attribution are NOT confirmed (the search was cut). The July 2026 ex-dividend day showed a mechanical -12.8%.
findings.why_not_priced: If a near-term capital return were priced, the stock would not trade at about 0.65x net cash. The discount says the market assigns it a low probability, or a heavy China-cash haircut. Not knowing whether anything is announced on 11-24 is why the band is wide and the point estimate small.
findings.independence: Cash figure: Q2 2026 release (https://finviz.com/news/385484/noah-holdings-limited-announces-unaudited-financial-results-for-the-second-quarter-of-2026). Q1 buyback: https://finviz.com/news/358040/noah-reports-q1-2026-earnings-transformation-momentum-continues-driven-by-scalable-ai-breakthroughs-and-long-term-growth-engines. findings.finding: The full-year guide is protected. Operating margin was 37.8% in Q1 and 34.8% in Q2 2026 (H1 op income RMB452.2M on revenue RMB1,245.7M). The only guide is 'full-year operating margin above 30%', so a weak Q3 is unlikely to force a guidance cut unless H2 margins fall below about 22%.

findings.why_not_priced: Small: the guide is qualitative, and holders appear to trade on revenue trend and China sentiment rather than margin.

findings.finding: Legacy litigation provisions are being released. Contingent liabilities fell from RMB505M (2026-03-31) to RMB455M (2026-06-30). Over 80% of affected clients accepted the new settlement plan, and the CFO said settlements are concluding 'on average below our current provisional level'. Q2 booked a RMB7.7M reversal, so further reversals in Q3 are plausible.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 carried a RMB7.7M reversal, and the stock moved -0.7%.
findings.why_not_priced: Below operating income, with no path to the guide, so it is sized at a fraction. The market has not valued the RMB455M provision gap explicitly, judging by the sub-cash price.
findings.independence: The Q2 release lists the RMB7.7M reversal: https://finviz.com/news/385484/noah-holdings-limited-announces-unaudited-financial-results-for-the-second-quarter-of-2026.

baseline_tension: The baseline has no skew and no usable chain. The fundamental read on the quarter is negative (carry collapse, international decline), but it agrees with the -8.2% 20-day run-up and the -27% drift since the last print, so it is probably priced. The only clearly unpriced upside is a capital-return surprise on a stock at about 0.65x cash. Net: p_up stays near 50.
lessons_applied: Lesson 5 (a proxy is filed small): the A-share-to-Noah carry finding went from -1.0 to -0.8. It is macro transmission that the company confirmed only in direction ('July adjustment').

Lesson 2 (one-offs at a fraction): the equity-affiliate mark-to-market went from -0.5 to -0.3, because holders bought the Q1 print that carried the same item. The litigation reversal went from +0.3 to +0.2.

Lesson 7 (look up short interest before a negative): it could not be looked up because the search budget was refused, and the stock is -48.8% from its high, so the international/regulatory negative went from -0.8 to -0.6.
Lesson 6 (bar unsourced): every finding is capped at or below 1 point except the capital-return band. The sizes were already in that range, so nothing else moved.

Lesson 'rebuild the history from confirmed releases': the base rate was rebuilt from Yahoo closes on the three confirmed releases (-0.7%, +2.8%, -0.7%). abs_move_pct went from 4.5 to 4.0 and p_up from 47 to 48.
